source.title: DANR Laboratory Certification roster + DANR Private Well Sampling + SD DOH Environmental Testing / Test a Private Well / Environmental Testing Fees
limitations: DANR LaboratoryCert.aspx lists in-state labs: South Dakota State Health Laboratory (Pierre), Sioux Falls Public Health Laboratory, Mid Continent Testing Laboratory (Rapid City), American Engineering Testing (Sioux Falls), plus many out-of-state labs.
State Health Laboratory is the verified private-person kit path via SD DOH Environmental Health Laboratory — documented in verified_paths only, not as a commercial table row.
Sioux Falls Public Health Laboratory is municipal/public health (Microbiology only on DANR list). Private-well acceptance unknown — documented in a short note, not as a commercial row.
Commercial table: Mid Continent Testing Laboratory and American Engineering Testing only. accepts_private_wells unknown — call first for both.
Out-of-state labs on DANR page omitted from main table — cite/link DANR Laboratory Certification only.

DOH bottle-order page states fee information is included with bottles and bottles are also available from County Extension offices. Official Environmental Testing Fees page lists dollar amounts (content last updated September 14, 2026) — this directory links that page rather than republishing a fee table that may change.
Prices for commercial labs intentionally omitted.

verified_paths.name: SD DOH Public Health Laboratory / Environmental Health Laboratory — private-person testing kits
verified_paths.notes: DOH Environmental Testing: private persons need a testing kit from the Department of Health or a special location; follow kit instructions. DANR offers private well testing information. Bottle order: https://doh.sd.gov/laboratory/environmental-testing/test-a-private-well/ — fee information included with bottles; bottles also available from County Extension offices. Contact Rea Riggle / Kristy Deal at 605-773-3368. DANR Laboratory Certification lists South Dakota State Health Laboratory: Laboratory Building, 615 East Fourth Street, Pierre, South Dakota 57501; 605-773-3368; Contact person Rea Riggle; certified for Inorganics, SOC's, VOC's, Chlorite, HAA5, Perchlorate, TTHM's, Microbiology, E.Coli enumeration, Chlorite. DOH page also lists 615 E 4th Street Pierre, toll-free 1-800-738-2301 (in SD only), fax 605-773-6129, Rea.Riggle@state.sd.us. Fees: see official Environmental Testing Fees page (do not invent; confirm current amounts).
